messages:
Alex T: Quick heads-up — we need a design review for the new multi-route batching feature (API + SDK + Console UX).
Alex T: Proposed agenda: 1) goals & success metrics, 2) API surface + backward compatibility, 3) SDK ergonomics & examples, 4) Console rollout UX and flags, 5) migration/telemetry and rollout plan.
Alex T: Pre-read checklist below — please skim and leave comments by EOD Tue if you can. Also: who must be on this? @Priya @Maria G @Samir K @Jon B
Maria G: I can join. Prefer Thu afternoon. 1 question: how long should we plan? 60 or 90m?
Priya N: Wed morning only for me (can do 10-11). Thu afternoon conflicts with customer call.
Samir K: Thu 3-4 works for me otherwise I can do Wed 10-11.
Jon B: Add "migration strategy" and "observability hooks" to agenda please.
Alex T: Good call, Jon — added migration + telemetry as #5 and will surface specific telemetry props.
Alex T: Pre-read checklist (paste for convenience):
```
- Read API RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-multi-route-batching
- Review SDK proposal PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/784 (focus on ergonomics section)
- Console mockups: https://www.figma.com/file/AbCd/multi-route-rollout (pages: UX > Rollout)
- Perf notes: /docs/perf/multi-route-summary.md
- Leave comments or :thumbsup: by EOD Tue
```
Maria G: Sounds good. If people want a longer session we can do 90m but I prefer a focused 60m with clear action items.
Priya N: If Wed 10-11 is chosen, I can cover Console UX. If Thu, I can record a short walkthrough and send link.
Samir K: +1 to 60m with follow-up working session if needed.
Alex T: Ok — poll results: majority prefer Thu afternoon. Scheduling compromise: Thu 14:30-16:00 (90m) to give time for deep discussion and follow-up tasks. If this blocks anyone, say now.
Priya N: Thu 14:30-16:00 won't work for me (conflict). Can we keep notes + recording please?
Jon B: I'm good for Thu 14:30-16:00. Will prepare migration plan slide.
calendar-bot: Poll created: https://calendar.internal/meeting/1763239999 — tentative invite will go to participants.
design-bot: Added Console mockups to the thread and annotated key screens (see comments on Figma).
Alex T: Thanks — I'll send the invite and pin the pre-reads to the event. Action items before the meeting:
- Everyone: leave comments on pre-reads by EOD Tue
- Jon: migration + telemetry slides
- Priya: if you can't make Thu, please upload a 5-7m Console walkthrough recording by Wed noon
- Samir: quick perf sanity check and notes in the perf doc
Alex T: I'll capture the meeting notes and follow-ups in the Design Review doc and create a short follow-up working session if we need to split implementation/ops items.
Maria G: Thanks — see you (or the recording) Thu afternoon. :rocket:
